constraint.formal: forall make_decision event d, forall PolicyVersion p with d governed_by p: effective_to(p) = "" (the policy in force has an open validity end; a non-empty effective_to marks a superseded version).
constraint.natural_language: Every decision must be governed by the policy version in force at decision time; a decision governed by a superseded policy version (one whose validity has ended) violates the constraint.

legal_basis.requirement: Providers establish and document a post-market monitoring system proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.

The post-market monitoring system actively and systematically collects and analyses relevant data on performance throughout the systems' lifetime, allowing the provider to evaluate continuous compliance with the requirements.

constraint.formal: forall make_decision event d with outcome in decision_outcomes, forall CreditDecision c produced by d: exists grant_approval event a such that a approves c, timestamp(a) < timestamp(d) (strict; an equal second does not satisfy), and a is performed_by a HumanApprover whose role is in allowed_roles.
constraint.natural_language: For every decision whose outcome requires human approval (grant, deny), a human approver holding an authorised role must have granted approval for that same decision strictly before the decision was made.

legal_basis.requirement: Human oversight measures must enable the persons overseeing the high-risk AI system to decide not to use it or to disregard, override or reverse its output.
Deployers assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority.

constraint.formal: forall make_decision event d, with A = the Application objects d concerns: the set { resource_type(x) : exists retrieve_data event r concerning some a in A with r reads DataResource x } is a superset of required_sources. Coverage is timestamp-agnostic by design.
constraint.natural_language: Every credit decision must rest on retrievals that cover all mandated data source types for the application concerned.

legal_basis.requirement: Training, validation and testing data sets must be relevant, sufficiently representative and, to the best extent possible, complete in view of the intended purpose.
High-risk AI systems must achieve an appropriate level of accuracy and robustness and perform consistently throughout their lifecycle.

constraint.formal: forall session s, forall Agent g performing at least one event within s: role(g) in entrypoint_roles, or exists handoff event h within s with to(h) = g and timestamp(h) strictly before g's first performed event in s; and the directed from->to handoff graph of s contains no cycle.
constraint.natural_language: No agent may act within a session without a preceding handoff delegating control to it, unless it is the session entrypoint; and no delegation chain within a session may contain a cycle.

legal_basis.requirement: Human oversight aims at preventing or minimising the risks that emerge when a high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under reasonably foreseeable misuse.
Deployers use high-risk AI systems in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying the systems.

constraint.formal: forall make_decision event d with outcome in adverse_outcomes, forall CreditDecision c produced by d: reason_codes(c) on the decision OBJECT is non-empty, and exists emit_reasoning event e with e explains c.
constraint.natural_language: Every adverse decision (deny, refer) must carry non-empty reason codes on the decision object and be explained by at least one reasoning event referencing that same decision.

legal_basis.requirement: High-risk AI systems must be sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret the system's output and use it appropriately.
Affected persons have the right to obtain from the deployer a clear and meaningful explanation of the role of the AI system in the decision-making procedure.

constraint.formal: forall retrieve_data or call_llm event e concerning an Application, forall DataResource x with e reads x: classification(x) in prohibited_classifications implies lawful_basis(x) is non-blank.
constraint.natural_language: No retrieval or model call concerning an application may read a special-category data resource unless that resource carries a recorded lawful basis documenting the bias-examination purpose.

legal_basis.requirement: Data governance must cover examination in view of possible biases and appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate them.
